### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
All stages advance conserved cell averages. There is no independent switch; the integrator sets the stage count.
Spatial and temporal order belong to the selected transport and integrator.
The flux increment is defined in @eq-ch02-laws-increment.
:::

### Derivation

Density $\rho$ has units $\mathrm{kg\,m^{-3}}$, momentum density $m_a$ has units
$\mathrm{kg\,m^{-2}\,s^{-1}}$, and total energy density $E$ has units $\mathrm{J\,m^{-3}}$.
The primitive velocities are contravariant and the conserved momenta covariant on the nonorthogonal grid.
Dry density and species partial densities obey separate continuity equations; summing them gives total continuity.
For an inviscid Cartesian cell without phase change,
$$
\begin{aligned}
\partial_t\rho_{\mathrm d}+\boldsymbol\nabla\cdot(\rho_{\mathrm d}\mathbf v)&=0,\\
\partial_t\rho_n+\boldsymbol\nabla\cdot(\rho_n\mathbf v)&=0,\\
\partial_t\mathbf m+\boldsymbol\nabla\cdot(\mathbf m\mathbf v+p\mathsf I)&=\rho\mathbf g,\\
\partial_t E+\boldsymbol\nabla\cdot[(E+p)\mathbf v]&=\rho\mathbf v\cdot\mathbf g.
\end{aligned}
$$
Here $\mathbf g=(g_1,g_2,g_3)$ is acceleration in $\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$.
Coriolis, diffusion and configured sources add their tendencies; geometric momentum terms enter through the
coordinate operator. Integration over a fixed cell changes the divergence into outward surface flux.
Dividing by its volume and replacing surface integrals by numerical area-weighted fluxes gives the
flux-only increment (shown in one dimension):

$$
\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_i=-\frac{\Delta t}{V_i}\Delta_i[A\mathbf F_1]
$$ {#eq-ch02-laws-increment}

@eq-ch02-laws-increment is implemented by `du` in [`hydro_forward.cpp:754-765`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L754-L765).

Summing $V_i\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_i$ cancels each shared interior face, leaving boundary fluxes.
This cancellation is exact algebra when both neighbours use the same flux; accuracy of that flux is separate.
The check `laws_check.py` verifies this telescoping identity and the wall-copy ordering.

Phase adjustment changes interior composition after transport. A wall ghost copied before adjustment retains
old composition; reconstruction then sees a jump not present in the adjusted interior. Copying afterward makes
the reflected thermodynamic state equal again. This proves consistency of the copied state, not a universal
conservation guarantee for an arbitrary reconstruction or boundary condition.

### Numerical method

The hydro operator reconstructs cell states at faces, limits fluxes, forms divergence, applies native forcings,
and performs VIC if present. User stage callbacks run after the hydro return, before RK averaging.
The averaged state is limited, solids are refilled, the last stage adjusts saturation, the applicable gravity
fixer runs, and physical boundaries are filled. [`meshblock.cpp:754-841`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L754-L841) documents `apply_boundaries` at the end.
EOS conversions themselves have no spatial stencil. Ghost exchange and seam flux agreement belong to Chapters 3 and 7.

### Limits

`NMASS>0` is refused by the `ICY` static assertion in the Code table. Limiter and source operations can change
conserved budgets. A spatial convergence order for the complete stage is not measured here.
Switch-combination coverage remains pending in @sec-ch12-matrix.
